previous_statement: The same correction estimate and the product-norm axiom give ||A bold-dot W-(U bold-dot V) bold-dot W||<(1+1/64)*84*2*epsilon_r<171*epsilon_r and ||U bold-dot(V bold-dot W)-U bold-dot B||<171*epsilon_r.
new_statement: Writing A=mu(U,V) and B=mu(V,W), the same correction estimate gives ||A-U bold-dot V||<=84*epsilon_r and ||B-V bold-dot W||<=84*epsilon_r. By bilinearity, the product-norm axiom, epsilon_r<=1/64, and ||U||,||W||<=2, one has ||A bold-dot W-(U bold-dot V) bold-dot W||<= (1+1/64)*84*2*epsilon_r <=171*epsilon_r and ||U bold-dot(V bold-dot W)-U bold-dot B||<= (1+1/64)*84*2*epsilon_r <=171*epsilon_r.
